new.n: Banker's $35,000 buried before the Civil War, La Pointe (Madeline Island)
new.pl: GNIS La Pointe, Madeline Island; cache spot not located
new.st: A La Pointe banker closed the bank in 1861, kept $2,000 and buried about $35,000 rather than carry it through wild country, then was killed in the Civil War in 1862. In 1897 a relative found a memo in his hand in an old book and the family came to hunt, but the trees and landmarks it named were gone. Pin is the village point, not the spot itself.
new.t: One Milwaukee Journal story; the same 1897 item says old island settlers denied it was borne out by the facts. Record unless a second account turns up. Village/private: permission.
src: Ashland Weekly News 1897-06-30 p1 (reprinting the Milwaukee Journal)
pinev: Village-level: GNIS La Pointe; the memo's trees and landmarks were gone by 1897 (about 1.5 km).
